items.html: And behold, the counterpart of Abba and Ima are ZA and Rachel, who are equal in their stature; and the counterpart of Yisrael Saba and Tevuna are Jacob and Rachel the small, from the chest of ZA downward. Understand this. And know that there is a Jacob who is the lower half of ZA, and he is the one who couples with Rachel the small. And there is a Jacob and Leah, the aspect of the posteriors of Abba and Ima.
